links.comparator_used: Generated responses without the second LLM-based classifier refinement step
links.outcome: Final answer quality against gold answers (ROUGE-1 recall, BERTScore precision, Intersection over Union)
links.effect: ROUGE-1 recall reduced by 13% and BERT precision reduced by 11%; Intersection over Union increased by 24%
links.tradeoff: Lower ROUGE-1 recall and BERT precision after refinement
links.quote: A second LLM-based classifier, used to refine the generated responses, resulted in an overall reduction in ROUGE-1 recall by 13% and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) precision by 11%.

design_hint: LLM classifier to defer high-risk queries and refine responses in RAG pipeline
